timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1520–1530 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently weak (high KRW per USD), making your dollar conversion more expensive than ideal. However, the rate has stabilized in the 1500s range for 24 consecutive trading days and is expected to fluctuate in the early-1530s band due to Middle East geopolitical uncertainty, suggesting no clear directional trend that would make waiting obviously better.

TIP: Since you must convert $2,000 monthly regardless, consider splitting your purchase across 2–3 dates each month to average out daily volatility rather than timing a single lump conversion.
